author: New China TV
description: On China's Cultural and Natural Heritage Day, meet 22-year-old Jiang Qi, who earned a Guinness World Records title by rotating an over-eight-metre Zhongfan pole around her body 19 times in 30 seconds. Her achievement brings new vitality to this time-honored Chinese art.
title: 22-year-old sets Guinness record with traditional Zhongfan skills

author: New China TV
description: This year marks the 70th anniversary of diplomatic relations between China and Egypt. A gala concert was staged by China's Suzhou Symphony Orchestra in Cairo to mark the occasion, promoting exchanges between the two countries through music. #China #Egypt #SuzhouSymphony (recorded)
title: When music bridges civilizations: Gala concert marking 70 yrs of Egypt-China ties

author: New China TV
description: Lose yourself in the beauty of Xinjiang in June. On China's Cultural & Natural Heritage Day, explore Kalajun Grassland and Qiongkushitai Village, both part of the Xinjiang Tianshan UNESCO World Heritage Site in Tekes County. (recorded) #China #Xinjiang #WorldHeritage #Tekes #Kalajun
title: Exploring beauty of Xinjiang Tianshan World Heritage Site

title: Xinhua News | Pakistani PM says U.S.-Iran peace deal likely to be reached in next 24 hours

author: New China TV
description: From fan merchandise produced in China's #Yiwu to pop-culture icon #Labubu which featured at the #WorldCup opening ceremony. From transportation systems to Chinese tech company's AI solutions that help keep everything running smoothly. Chinese elements are making their mark at the soccer feast, showcasing a profound blend of culture, innovation, and global influence. #WorldCup2026
title: Chinese elements making their mark at FIFA World Cup 2026

author: New China TV
description: Check out this amazing aerial view of the Xiamen section of the Xiamen-Kinmen Bridge project under construction in east China's Fujian Province. It serves to link Xiamen island to Xiang'an International Airport and includes a reserved interface for a future extension to Kinmen. #MegaProject #China
title: Construction of mega sea-crossing bridge in full swing in Xiamen, China

title: Helicopter rescues injured herb collector stranded in China's Qinling Mountains

author: New China TV
description: In Bosnia and Herzegovina(BiH), the Bileca PV-plus-storage project, a landmark collaboration project between BiH and China, marks a turning point for the country's energy transition. #GLOBALink
title: GLOBALink | China-built solar project wins trust in Bosnia and Herzegovina

author: New China TV
description: Chinese President Xi Jinping has made the preservation of China's cultural heritage a consistent focus of state governance. Check this video to see his guidance on protecting cultural relics during his visits to many heritage sites.
title: Xi Jinping's deep care for Chinese cultural heritage

author: New China TV
description:
In China's coastal city of Qingdao, marine enterprises are sourcing ingredients globally, developing high-value products, and serving customers across international markets.
Let's see how Chinese companies are moving beyond resource processing to create new opportunities in the global marine economy.
title: From world to world: How China's marine companies are creating value globally

author: New China TV
description: Join us in Boshan, Shandong Province, one of China’s renowned ceramic centers, as we explore the thousand-year-old Yanshen Ancient Town. Together with ceramic artists from China, Estonia and Bulgaria, we will discover traditional porcelain-making techniques, historic kilns, contemporary ceramic art studios, and the cultural exchanges shaping modern ceramic creation. Through this journey, experience how Chinese ceramic art continues to connect civilizations through a shared pursuit of beauty. (Recorded)
title: LIVE: Exploring China's Ceramic Heritage in Boshan: A Journey Through Yanshen Ancient Town

author: New China TV
description: A winding road takes a serene path across the mirror-like surface of Pingtian Lake in Chizhou City, east China's Anhui Province. #Anhui #China #PingtianLake
title: Surreal beauty of mirror-like Pingtian Lake

author: New China TV
description: Iran's Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi said Friday night that the signing of a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the United States to end the war could take place within the next few days. #XinhuaNews
title: Xinhua News | Iran's FM says signing of MoU with U.S. possible within few days

author: New China TV
description:
Do you know why lakes are called "seas" in Mongolian?
Because on the grassland, every lake is as precious as the ocean.
Once a stinky, fading wetland in Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region, Ulan Suhai Lake is now a reborn paradise for over 260 bird species! The secret? Follow us to find out.
title: Inner Side Out | How did Inner Mongolia turn a polluted lake into a bird paradise?

author: New China TV
description: In Shoushan Village, east China's Fujian Province, over 50 historic Ming and Qing dynasty houses anchor a living experiment in rural revival.  Here, an old grain station has been reborn as a garden art space, locals livestream handmade crafts sales, and tea houses brew both culture and income.
title: Centuries-old village, modern hustle: Shoushan's new livelihoods
